description: Granite peaks meet the Atlantic on Mount Desert Island. Rocky headlands, cobble beaches, carriage roads and the first sunrise in the contiguous United States from the summit of Cadillac Mountain. Cool, humid summers and long snowy winters.
name: Acadia National Park
weather_info: Cool, humid summers and long snowy winters.

description: Over 2,000 natural sandstone arches above the high Colorado Plateau desert near Moab. Slickrock fins, balanced rocks and red rock spires. Blazing dry summers, mild spring and fall, light winter snow.
name: Arches National Park
weather_info: Blazing dry summers, mild spring and fall, light winter snow.

description: Sharply eroded buttes, pinnacles and spires rising from the largest protected mixed-grass prairie in the country. Rich fossil beds, bison and bighorn sheep. Hot summers, bitter windy winters.
name: Badlands National Park
weather_info: Hot summers, bitter windy winters.

alerts.description: The Chisos Basin campground, lodge and restaurant are closed through the spring season for emergency water system replacement. Day use of Chisos Basin trails remains open. No water is available in the basin - carry all you need.
alerts.title: Chisos Basin water system repairs

description: Where the Chihuahuan Desert meets the Rio Grande and the Chisos Mountains. Vast, remote and famously dark at night. Desert floor stays warm and mild through winter and spring while the high Chisos stay cool.
name: Big Bend National Park
weather_info: Desert floor stays warm and mild through winter and spring while the high Chisos stay cool.

description: Ninety-five percent water: turquoise bay, living coral reefs, mangrove shoreline and the northernmost Florida Keys. Reached almost entirely by boat. Warm and humid year round, with a wet summer season.
name: Biscayne National Park
weather_info: Warm and humid year round, with a wet summer season.

description: A narrow, sheer-walled gorge so deep and steep that parts of it get only 33 minutes of sunlight a day. Dramatic rim overlooks above the Gunnison River. Snowy winters close the north rim road.
name: Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
weather_info: Snowy winters close the north rim road.

description: Not a canyon but a series of natural amphitheaters filled with thousands of orange and pink hoodoos. High elevation means cool summers, heavy winter snow, and some of the darkest skies in the country.
name: Bryce Canyon National Park
weather_info: High elevation means cool summers, heavy winter snow, and some of the darkest skies in the country.

description: A high desert carved into countless canyons, mesas and buttes by the Green and Colorado rivers. Four remote districts, little water, and long views. Hot summers, cold clear winters.
name: Canyonlands National Park
weather_info: Hot summers, cold clear winters.

description: A hundred-mile wrinkle in the earth called the Waterpocket Fold, with cliffs, domes, slot canyons and historic Fruita orchards. Dry and sunny, with hot summers and cool nights.
name: Capitol Reef National Park
weather_info: Dry and sunny, with hot summers and cool nights.

description: More than 119 known caves beneath the Chihuahuan Desert, including an enormous chamber reached by elevator or a steep natural entrance. Famous summer evening bat flights. The cave stays 56 degrees year round.
name: Carlsbad Caverns National Park
weather_info: The cave stays 56 degrees year round.

description: Five rugged islands off the southern California coast with sea caves, kelp forests and species found nowhere else. Reached by boat, no services on most islands. Cool, foggy and windy.
name: Channel Islands National Park
weather_info: Cool, foggy and windy.

description: The largest intact old-growth bottomland hardwood forest left in the southeast, with some of the tallest trees in eastern North America. Floodplain boardwalks and blackwater paddling. Hot humid summers, mild winters.
name: Congaree National Park
weather_info: Hot humid summers, mild winters.

alerts.description: Most of Rim Drive and the north entrance are closed by deep snow. Only the south entrance and Rim Village are plowed in winter.
alerts.title: Rim Drive closed by snow

description: The deepest lake in the United States, an impossibly blue caldera left by the collapse of an ancient volcano. Heavy snow buries the rim most of the year; the rim road is only fully open in late summer.
name: Crater Lake National Park
weather_info: Heavy snow buries the rim most of the year; the rim road is only fully open in late summer.

description: A pastoral river valley between Cleveland and Akron with waterfalls, towpath trail, wetlands and reforested farmland. Easy, gentle terrain and good accessible paths. Four distinct seasons.
name: Cuyahoga Valley National Park
weather_info: Four distinct seasons.

description: Six million acres of subarctic taiga and tundra around North America's highest peak. A single ninety-mile road, no marked trails in most of the park, and grizzly, caribou, Dall sheep and wolves. Brief cool summer, severe winter.
name: Denali National Park and Preserve
weather_info: Brief cool summer, severe winter.

alerts.description: Summer temperatures regularly exceed 120F. Hiking at low elevation after 10am is strongly discouraged. Multiple heat fatalities have occurred.
alerts.title: Extreme heat danger June through September

description: The hottest, driest and lowest place in North America. Salt flats below sea level, sand dunes, badlands and snow-capped peaks above. Winter and early spring are pleasant; summer is dangerously hot.
name: Death Valley National Park
weather_info: Winter and early spring are pleasant; summer is dangerously hot.

description: Seven small islands seventy miles west of Key West, built around a massive nineteenth-century brick fort, surrounded by coral reefs and shipwrecks. Reached only by boat or seaplane. Warm and breezy year round.
name: Dry Tortugas National Park
weather_info: Warm and breezy year round.

alerts.description: From June through November mosquito activity in the Flamingo and Shark Valley areas can be extreme and may make camping unpleasant.
alerts.title: Mosquito levels high in the wet season

description: The largest subtropical wilderness in the United States, a slow-moving river of sawgrass, mangrove and cypress. Alligators, manatees, crocodiles and over 360 bird species. Mild dry winters are the best season; summers are hot, wet and buggy.
name: Everglades National Park
weather_info: Mild dry winters are the best season; summers are hot, wet and buggy.

description: Entirely above the Arctic Circle with no roads, no trails and no campgrounds. Treeless tundra, glacial valleys and the central Brooks Range. Access by bush plane only.
name: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve
weather_info: Access by bush plane only.

description: An urban park on the St. Louis riverfront centered on a 630-foot stainless steel arch commemorating westward expansion, with a museum below and a tram to the top. Fully paved and highly accessible.
name: Gateway Arch National Park
weather_info: Fully paved and highly accessible.

alerts.description: Seasonal snow closure. The alpine section of Going-to-the-Sun Road including Logan Pass typically does not open until late June or early July.
alerts.title: Going-to-the-Sun Road closed beyond Avalanche Creek

description: A million acres of carved peaks, hanging valleys, turquoise lakes and remnant glaciers along the Continental Divide. The Going-to-the-Sun Road is a highlight but is snowbound well into summer.
name: Glacier National Park
weather_info: The Going-to-the-Sun Road is a highlight but is snowbound well into summer.

description: Tidewater glaciers calving into cold saltwater fjords, with humpback whales, sea otters and a landscape still rebounding from ice. Mostly experienced by boat. Cool, wet and overcast.
name: Glacier Bay National Park and Preserve
weather_info: Cool, wet and overcast.

description: A mile-deep, 277-mile-long gorge exposing two billion years of rock layers along the Colorado River. The South Rim is open all year; the higher North Rim closes in winter. Inner canyon summer heat is extreme.
name: Grand Canyon National Park
weather_info: Inner canyon summer heat is extreme.

description: Abrupt granite peaks rising straight out of the sagebrush flats of Jackson Hole, with glacial lakes, moose, elk and bison. Short cool summers, deep snowy winters.
name: Grand Teton National Park
weather_info: Short cool summers, deep snowy winters.

description: An isolated desert mountain range with ancient bristlecone pines, a small glacier, and the ornate Lehman Caves. Among the darkest night skies in the lower 48. Snow closes the high scenic drive.
name: Great Basin National Park
weather_info: Snow closes the high scenic drive.

description: The tallest sand dunes in North America piled against the Sangre de Cristo Mountains, with a seasonal creek at their base. Sand surface temperatures soar in summer afternoons.
name: Great Sand Dunes National Park and Preserve
weather_info: Sand surface temperatures soar in summer afternoons.

alerts.description: All vehicles parking for more than 15 minutes must display a valid parking tag, available daily, weekly or annually.
alerts.title: Parking tag required

description: Ancient, misty, densely forested southern Appalachian ridges with extraordinary biodiversity, historic homesteads and spring wildflowers. The most visited national park. Humid summers, mild snowy winters.
name: Great Smoky Mountains National Park
weather_info: Humid summers, mild snowy winters.

description: An uplifted ancient marine fossil reef rising from the Chihuahuan Desert, with the highest peak in Texas and a hidden high-country forest. Spectacular autumn color in McKittrick Canyon.
name: Guadalupe Mountains National Park
weather_info: Spectacular autumn color in McKittrick Canyon.

alerts.description: Entry to the summit area between 3am and 7am requires a reservation obtained online in advance. Reservations are released 60 days ahead.
alerts.title: Sunrise viewing requires an advance reservation

description: A vast dormant volcanic summit depression above the clouds, plus a separate rainforest and waterfall coast at Kipahulu. Freezing sunrise temperatures at the summit, tropical warmth at sea level.
name: Haleakala National Park
weather_info: Freezing sunrise temperatures at the summit, tropical warmth at sea level.

description: Two active volcanoes, Kilauea and Mauna Loa, with steam vents, lava tubes, craters and newly formed coastline. Landscapes change with each eruption. Warm at the coast, cool and rainy at the summit.
name: Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
weather_info: Warm at the coast, cool and rainy at the summit.

description: Thermal springs flowing out of Hot Springs Mountain, with a historic row of early twentieth-century bathhouses and shaded urban trails. The smallest national park. Hot humid summers, mild winters.
name: Hot Springs National Park
weather_info: Hot humid summers, mild winters.

description: Fifteen miles of Lake Michigan shoreline with high sand dunes, oak savanna, bogs and marshes crowded against heavy industry. Remarkable plant diversity. Hot humid summers, cold windy winters.
name: Indiana Dunes National Park
weather_info: Hot humid summers, cold windy winters.

description: A remote wilderness island in Lake Superior with no roads or cars, reached by ferry or seaplane, known for backpacking, canoeing, wolves and moose. Closed entirely in winter.
name: Isle Royale National Park
weather_info: Closed entirely in winter.

description: Where the high Mojave and low Colorado deserts meet, with twisted Joshua trees, enormous granite boulder piles, hidden oases and world-class rock climbing. Winter and spring are mild and pleasant; summer is severe.
name: Joshua Tree National Park
weather_info: Winter and spring are mild and pleasant; summer is severe.

description: Brown bears fishing for salmon at Brooks Falls, plus the ash-filled Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes left by a massive 1912 eruption. Reached by float plane. Cool, wet and windy.
name: Katmai National Park and Preserve
weather_info: Cool, wet and windy.

description: An immense icefield spilling nearly forty glaciers down to the Gulf of Alaska, with puffins, sea lions, orcas and whales in the fjords below. Mostly seen by boat; one glacier is road accessible.
name: Kenai Fjords National Park
weather_info: Mostly seen by boat; one glacier is road accessible.

description: Giant sequoia groves and one of the deepest canyons in North America, backed by a huge roadless stretch of the High Sierra. Deep snow closes the high country much of the year.
name: Kings Canyon National Park
weather_info: Deep snow closes the high country much of the year.

description: Arctic sand dunes, boreal forest and the Kobuk River crossed twice yearly by a vast caribou migration. No roads, no trails, no facilities.
name: Kobuk Valley National Park
weather_info: No roads, no trails, no facilities.

description: Active volcanoes, turquoise lakes, salmon runs and coastal brown bears in a roadless landscape across Cook Inlet from Anchorage. Access by small plane.
name: Lake Clark National Park and Preserve
weather_info: Access by small plane.

description: All four types of volcano in one place, with boiling mudpots, fumaroles, sulphur works and clear mountain lakes. Enormous winter snowpack keeps the main road closed into early summer.
name: Lassen Volcanic National Park
weather_info: Enormous winter snowpack keeps the main road closed into early summer.

description: The longest known cave system in the world, with over 400 mapped miles of passages beneath a green river valley of oak and hickory forest. Cave temperature is a constant 54 degrees.
name: Mammoth Cave National Park
weather_info: Cave temperature is a constant 54 degrees.

description: Nearly 5,000 archaeological sites including spectacular Ancestral Pueblo cliff dwellings tucked beneath canyon overhangs on a high pinyon-juniper mesa. Many sites require steep ladders; most close in winter.
name: Mesa Verde National Park
weather_info: Many sites require steep ladders; most close in winter.

alerts.description: Vehicle reservations are required for the Paradise and Sunrise corridors during peak summer hours.
alerts.title: Timed entry reservations required in summer

description: An enormous active glaciated stratovolcano looming over old-growth forest and famous subalpine wildflower meadows. The most heavily glaciated peak in the contiguous United States. Very wet, with huge snowfall.
name: Mount Rainier National Park
weather_info: Very wet, with huge snowfall.

description: Jagged peaks, over 300 glaciers and deep forested valleys in one of the most rugged and least developed ranges in the country. Mostly trail and climbing access.
name: North Cascades National Park
weather_info: Mostly trail and climbing access.

description: Tropical rainforest, coral reefs and steep volcanic ridges across three South Pacific islands, managed with Samoan villages. Hot, humid and rainy year round.
name: National Park of American Samoa
weather_info: Hot, humid and rainy year round.

description: Three distinct worlds in one park: wild Pacific beaches, temperate rainforest dripping with moss, and glaciated interior peaks. One of the wettest places in the lower 48.
name: Olympic National Park
weather_info: One of the wettest places in the lower 48.

description: Brilliantly colored petrified logs and Triassic fossils scattered across the banded badlands of the Painted Desert, with Route 66 and petroglyph sites. Dry, windy, hot summers and cold winters.
name: Petrified Forest National Park
weather_info: Dry, windy, hot summers and cold winters.

description: Eroded remnants of an ancient volcano moved along the San Andreas Fault, with rock spires, talus caves and reintroduced California condors. Very hot in summer; spring wildflowers are the draw.
name: Pinnacles National Park
weather_info: Very hot in summer; spring wildflowers are the draw.

description: The tallest trees on earth in a cool coastal fog belt, with prairies, oak woodlands and forty miles of wild shoreline. Mild and damp all year.
name: Redwood National and State Parks
weather_info: Mild and damp all year.

alerts.description: Trail Ridge Road is closed by snow between Many Parks Curve and the Colorado River trailhead. Typical reopening is late May.
alerts.title: Trail Ridge Road closed for the season

description: Alpine tundra above treeline reached by the highest continuous paved road in the country, with elk, bighorn sheep, glacial lakes and over sixty peaks above 12,000 feet. Trail Ridge Road is closed by snow most of the year.
name: Rocky Mountain National Park
weather_info: Trail Ridge Road is closed by snow most of the year.

description: Dense forests of giant saguaro cactus across two desert districts flanking Tucson, with petroglyphs and a cool sky-island forest on the Rincon crest. Winter and early spring are warm and ideal; summer is extreme.
name: Saguaro National Park
weather_info: Winter and early spring are warm and ideal; summer is extreme.

description: Home to the largest trees on earth in the Giant Forest, plus deep canyons, marble caverns and the highest summit in the contiguous United States. Snow closes the high roads in winter.
name: Sequoia National Park
weather_info: Snow closes the high roads in winter.

description: A long narrow park along the Blue Ridge, strung together by Skyline Drive with waterfalls, hollows, overlooks and regrowing Appalachian forest. Spectacular autumn color; humid summers.
name: Shenandoah National Park
weather_info: Spectacular autumn color; humid summers.

description: Colorful Little Missouri badlands and rolling prairie with free-roaming bison, wild horses and prairie dog towns, in the landscape that shaped a young Roosevelt. Hot summers, severe winters.
name: Theodore Roosevelt National Park
weather_info: Hot summers, severe winters.

description: Covering most of St. John, with white sand beaches, snorkeling trails over coral reefs, sugar plantation ruins and dry tropical forest. Warm and breezy, with a late-summer hurricane season.
name: Virgin Islands National Park
weather_info: Warm and breezy, with a late-summer hurricane season.

description: A water-based park of interconnected lakes, bogs and rocky islands on the Canadian border, traveled by boat in summer and ice road in winter. Northern lights and loons.
name: Voyageurs National Park
weather_info: Northern lights and loons.

description: The world's largest gypsum dune field, 275 square miles of brilliant white sand in the Tularosa Basin. Dunes are easy to reach and nearly level, though full sun is relentless.
name: White Sands National Park
weather_info: Dunes are easy to reach and nearly level, though full sun is relentless.

description: One of the world's longest and most complex caves, famous for delicate boxwork formations, beneath rolling mixed-grass prairie and ponderosa forest with bison and elk.
name: Wind Cave National Park
weather_info: One of the world's longest and most complex caves, famous for delicate boxwork formations, beneath rolling mixed-grass prairie and ponderosa forest with bison and elk.

description: The largest national park in the United States, bigger than Switzerland, with colliding mountain ranges, enormous glaciers, nine of the sixteen highest US peaks and the historic Kennecott copper mill.
name: Wrangell-St. Elias National Park and Preserve
weather_info: The largest national park in the United States, bigger than Switzerland, with colliding mountain ranges, enormous glaciers, nine of the sixteen highest US peaks and the historic Kennecott copper mill.

description: The world's first national park, sitting on an active supervolcano with half the planet's geysers, hot springs and mudpots, plus bison, wolves, grizzlies and the Lamar Valley. Most roads close to cars in winter.
name: Yellowstone National Park
weather_info: Most roads close to cars in winter.

alerts.description: Both high-country roads are closed for the winter season and typically reopen between late May and July depending on snowpack.
alerts.title: Tioga Road and Glacier Point Road closed

description: Sheer granite walls, towering waterfalls, giant sequoias and high Sierra meadows. The valley floor is accessible and open all year; Tioga Road and the high country are snowbound most of it.
name: Yosemite National Park
weather_info: The valley floor is accessible and open all year; Tioga Road and the high country are snowbound most of it.

description: A deep, narrow sandstone canyon with sheer 2,000-foot walls, the Virgin River narrows, hanging gardens and slot canyons. Shuttle access in the main canyon. Hot summers, mild winters, flash flood risk.
name: Zion National Park
weather_info: Hot summers, mild winters, flash flood risk.
